baseline_models.focus_anchor: qul, basharun mithlukum, and yuha ilayya
baseline_models.mechanism: The declaration holds sameness and asymmetry together: shared humanity blocks elevation of the speaker, hidden incoming knowledge differentiates his access, and commanded speech makes that receipt public.

activation_trace.role: Vocalized saying carries received content into public address.
The visibly human category fixes the speaker within shared creaturely status.
Likeness establishes parity between speaker and audience.
Hidden conveyance supplies the asymmetric channel without changing the receiver's humanity.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is an ordinary human who also reports revelation.
changed_reading.after: The speaker is a human interface: ontologically level with the audience, asymmetrically receptive, and responsible for voicing what arrives.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ilahukum ilahun wahidun and wa-la yushrik bi-ibadati rabbihi ahadan
baseline_models.mechanism: One divine addressee makes worship structurally non-shareable: no participant may be inserted into the relation, and the final indefinite negative closes every exception.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped object grounds the sentence's divine referent.
Unpartnered divine unity supplies the exclusion principle.
Participation and shared ownership make the prohibited intrusion relationally concrete.
Submissive worship names the relation that must remain undivided.
Exhaustive negation removes every possible personal exception.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states monotheism and forbids idolatry.
changed_reading.after: The ayah specifies an architecture of allegiance: worship cannot be jointly owned, delegated, or populated by any additional patron.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: yarju liqaa rabbihi fal-ya'mal amalan salihan
baseline_models.mechanism: Anticipated encounter supplies an endpoint; deliberate work is then tested for fitness to the Lord's governing and restorative relation rather than counted as generic activity.

activation_trace.role: The heart's projection toward what is hoped for gives present action a future pull.
Two parties coming into encounter supplies the action's terminal horizon.
Repair, nurture, and completion define the relation to which the work must answer.
Intentional doing supplies the present operation shaped by that horizon.
Fitness and suitability make salih a relational criterion, not a decorative label.

changed_reading.before: Whoever wants reward should perform good deeds.
changed_reading.after: Whoever lives toward encounter should make present labor fit the Lord's completing relation and keep its worshipal direction unshared.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turbulent intermingling followed by total collection reframes the singular terms in the focus: undivided allegiance is accountable individuation inside a gathered mass, not private withdrawal from it.

activation_trace.role: Interpenetrating turbulence supplies the social field in which distinctions blur.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the terminal collective assembly.
Singleness and separation preserve a non-merged axis of allegiance.
The exhaustive anyone makes each possible intruder individually answerable.

structural_cues: 18:99 moves from intermingled parts to total gathering; 18:110 shifts to whoever and anyone in the singular.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mass turbulence, collection, and singular exclusions; I infer a move from aggregation to accountable individuation. Alternatively, the focus singulars may serve only theological exclusion.

changed_reading.before: The closing instruction is a private rule for an isolated believer.
changed_reading.after: The closing instruction preserves undivided personal agency and allegiance even when everyone is swept together and finally assembled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covered perception and failed hearing turn revelation from a status marker into a reception contrast: hidden communication must enter a receptive human and then become hearable speech.

activation_trace.role: A covering that screens supplies the blockage on the receiving side.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception more than acoustics.
Hidden conveyance supplies successful inward receipt.
Spoken output exposes what was inwardly received to public hearing.

structural_cues: 18:101 pairs covered eyes with inability to hear; 18:110 pairs hidden receipt with an imperative to say.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked perception, successful hidden receipt, and spoken output; I infer a receive-then-transmit channel. Alternatively, 18:101 may describe culpability without defining prophetic receptivity.

changed_reading.before: Revelation distinguishes the messenger by possession of information.
changed_reading.after: Revelation distinguishes him by permeability and transmission: he receives what screened hearers cannot admit and voices it without ceasing to be human.

context_deltas.mechanism: Taking God's servants as protecting allies gives shirk a social mechanism: ultimate dependence is transferred onto subordinate persons. The speaker's declared humanity then prevents his own reception as such a patron.

activation_trace.role: Servanthood places the proposed patrons inside, not above, the relation of obedience.
Protective love and alliance supply the relational function wrongly reassigned.
Participation names the insertion of a subordinate into an exclusive relation.
Exhaustive negation bars every servant, including the speaking human, from that role.

structural_cues: 18:102 proposes God's servants as allies besides Him; 18:110 declares the messenger human-like and excludes anyone from the Lord's worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies servants elevated into allies and the speaker's human parity; I infer that the final prohibition also blocks patronizing the messenger. Alternatively, 18:102 may target other servants without implicating his reception.

changed_reading.before: Do not add another deity to ritual worship.
changed_reading.after: Do not relocate ultimate trust, protection, or obedience onto any servant; even the revelatory human remains inside creaturely service, not beside its Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-approved skilled production can swell with apparent substance yet collapse without weight. Salih therefore becomes work fitted to survive encounter and external assay, not work certified by its maker.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the unreliable internal verdict that the work is good.
Skilled making shows that technical competence can coexist with failed direction.
Swelling from harmful intake supplies the contrast between apparent bulk and viable substance.
Weight as standing and worth supplies the external outcome the work fails to retain.
Suitability recasts good work as work adequate to its true end.

structural_cues: 18:103-105 repeats works, joins lost striving to self-approved craft, and then gives those works neither persistence nor weight after denial of meeting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-assessment, craft, collapse, weightlessness, and meeting; I infer that meeting functions as the assay for salih. Alternatively, the condemned works and the focus command may remain separate moral examples.

changed_reading.before: A good deed is recognizable from sincere effort or competent execution.
changed_reading.after: A salih work is end-fitted and encounter-surviving; effort, polish, and apparent volume cannot self-certify it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Righteous work is followed by a sheltered garden as prepared lodging, then by abiding without transfer. This spatializes salih as conduct fitted to a durable habitat rather than a detachable payment token.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden supplies a living, sheltered environment.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest makes the outcome inhabitable.
Stable persistence supplies temporal durability to the habitat.
The refused change of state supplies non-transfer away from that fit.
Fitness links present conduct to a future environment in which it belongs.

structural_cues: 18:107 couples righteous works with gardens as lodging; 18:108 adds permanence and no sought transfer before 18:110 commands fitting work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the work-lodging sequence and stable non-transfer; I infer formation toward habitat rather than mere payment for deeds. Alternatively, the relation may be strictly reward after action.

changed_reading.before: Good work purchases a later reward.
changed_reading.after: Fitting work forms a life capable of belonging in the prepared, stable ecology toward which encounter leads.

context_deltas.mechanism: A material writing supply and even its duplicate exhaust before the Lord's words; immediately afterward, a human-like receiver carries one revealed disclosure. Human limitation belongs to the medium, not to the source.

activation_trace.role: Ink feeding a pen supplies the finite material carrier for speech.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the inexhaustible communicated source.
Exhaustion marks the limit of every material reservoir.
A matching duplicate tests whether likeness can enlarge finite capacity.
The human receiver is another finite, visible carrier.
Hidden conveyance permits finite receipt without implying containment of the source.

structural_cues: 18:109 ends with mithlihi madadan after repeated sea, words, and exhaustion; 18:110 answers with basharun mithlukum yuha ilayya.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent likenesses, exhausted media, inexhaustible words, and a human receiver; I infer a scale transition from source to conduit. Alternatively, the repeated mithl may be only lexical echo.

changed_reading.before: The messenger's humanity limits the authority or scale of what he communicates.
changed_reading.after: His humanity identifies a finite conduit for an uncontained source: the disclosure is genuinely received without exhausting, embodying, or enlarging that source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary q-l-l mapping for qul, not the ordinary q-w-l reading. It remains anchored in the supplied split inventory, innama's restrictive shape, divine unity, and the preceding inexhaustible words. Render it only as a rhetorical compression activated by the split root, never as the verb's lexical derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: qul at the opening of a tightly restrictive, singular disclosure

activation_trace.role: Littleness and reduction let the speech command carry a pressure toward minimal formulation.
A meaningful word expanding into utterance contrasts vast verbal scope with the compact next saying.
Unshared unity is the compressed disclosure's central reduction.

changed_reading.before: Qul merely introduces the final proposition.
changed_reading.after: Qul also enacts compression: inexhaustible words are rendered through a finite human as a minimal directive centered on one God, fitted work, and unshared worship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's secondary m-r-j mapping under r-j-w and reinforces it with 18:99's wave image. It remains anchored to yarju and the imperative to work, but it should be presented as an affective possibility, not as the ordinary lexical meaning of hope.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: yarju liqaa rabbihi followed by fal-ya'mal

activation_trace.role: Restlessness in place turns hope into unsettled pressure rather than passive wishing.
Intermingling turbulence gives that affective instability a context image.
Intentional work channels unsettled anticipation toward a chosen end.

changed_reading.before: Hope for meeting is a calm wish that precedes action.
changed_reading.after: Hope may be a destabilizing anticipation whose turbulence is given direction and form by fitting work.

strongest_changes: Salih work becomes work that survives encounter and external weight, not work certified by effort, polish, or self-assessment.
Exclusive worship becomes refusal to transfer ultimate patronage onto any servant, including the revelatory human.
Human likeness and revelation become a finite-receiver mechanism for an inexhaustible source.
summary.what_was_special: The sequence moves through mass gathering, blocked reception, false work, durable lodging, and exhausted writing media, so the final ayah reads as a compact test of reception, fit, and undivided direction rather than a detached doctrinal summary.
remaining_uncertainties: The scale bridge built from mithl in 18:109 to mithlukum in 18:110 may be deliberate sequence pressure or only lexical echo.
The habitat reading may describe reward after action rather than formation toward a fitting environment.
The q-l-l and m-r-j split-root activations are exploratory mechanisms, not ordinary lexical derivations.
